title: Print Spooler Service is Running on Non-Print Server Endpoint (PrintNightmare Exposure)
description: The Windows Print Spooler service has a history of critical remote code execution and local privilege escalation vulnerabilities (PrintNightmare). Endpoints without physical printers should disable the spooler.
expected: Spooler Service Disabled or Inbound Remote Printing Blocked
impact: Adversaries on local network subnets can exploit Print Spooler RPC interfaces for privilege escalation or lateral movement.
remediation_guidance: Disable Print Spooler on non-print devices: Stop-Service -Name 'Spooler'; Set-Service -Name 'Spooler' -StartupType Disabled
